articles.title: XRP edges higher while bitcoin, ether and dogecoin slip, keeping focus on $1.49 breakout zone
articles.snippet: XRP outperformed major tokens during a volatile session, with a late volume burst pushing price back toward resistance that has capped rallies for weeks.

articles.title: Bitcoin Firm Metaplanet Posts $725 Million Loss, Delays Preferred Share Offerings
articles.snippet: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich acknowledged that preferred shares unveiled in November have yet to be issued.
